items.requirements: Home server / VMs (Docker, VMs, NAS, self-hosting). Must have >=64GB RAM installed and included in the price, >=512GB storage (or a cheap add), and be a complete working machine (not parts). An old multi-core Xeon workstation is fine, including DDR3-era ones (HP Z420/Z620, Dell T3600/T5600) where used 64GB DDR3 is very cheap; RAM capacity matters more than CPU speed. A dedicated GPU is nice to have only if included - don't pay extra for it. Used is fine; noise and power draw are not critical.
